summary: Corrects the sequence around frame-dotnet-plugin-20260915-orchestrator, which recorded ACCEPT before this was known. On the commit run, run_all.py printed OVERALL: FAIL, and the commit and push proceeded anyway. Cause of the proceeding: the shell chain gated the commit on findstr matching the string OVERALL, which matches PASS and FAIL alike, instead of on run_all's exit code. That is a process defect in how the check was invoked, not in the check. Cause of the FAIL itself: unknown and not reproducible - three subsequent runs pass, the last verified by exit code rather than by output text, and no step named a failing file. It is the second non-reproducible failure this session from run_all's nested subprocess spawning, after the 0xC0000005 crash recorded in frame-runtime-buildout-20260915-checker-002. The committed tree is verified green as it stands; the ACCEPT is sound in substance but was reached without the evidence being read. Recorded rather than quietly re-run, because a gate that was bypassed once will be bypassed again if the bypass is not written down.
